answer_1.quote: We demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of our proposed method on three common benchmarks that evaluate different LLM capabilities: conversational short-answer questions, commonsense multiple-choice reasoning, and code generation.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates rephrased prompts using persona-based LLMs to reflect diverse writing styles, which are then used to evaluate model performance on existing benchmarks.

answer_2.quote: We report results based on both recall (i.e., token-level overlap of the answer with correct gold labels...) and cosine similarity (considering the semantics between the answer and correct gold labels).

answer_3.quote: We then employ an LLM directly in our pipeline to determine whether the rephrased context entails all the ground-truth answers to the associated questions.
